Name: HxW Flower Paths for Alternative Textures
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center] [size=3] [img]https://i.imgur.com/buIbPlm.png[/img]


Looking for some MORE flowery, forest-y, cottagecore paths to pair with your flowery furniture﻿? or Perhaps your new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36501]FLORIST SHOP[/url]﻿? 

Of course you are! 

This mod adds 8 retextures for the cobblestone path to your game that look just like adorable flower paths! It uses
Alternative Textures, so no need for concern about compatibility with your other path mods. Choose from the regular OR toned down version in the files section and GET DECORATING![/size][size=3]

[b]How to use:[/b] simply purchase the paint bucket from Robin and[b] click on any cobblestone path [/b]you've placed to choose a new texture!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y8dJ6qH.png[/img]

Credit to my partner in crime [b][url=https://himetarts.wixsite.com/artsite]HimeTarts[/url][/b] for her gorgeous art and gorgeous self. <3

Credit to [url=https://ko-fi.com/ty_ty]Taiyo[/url] for our amazing flower bases !

Credit to [url=https://ko-fi.com/whitelotus]PlatinumCats[/url] for some of her small flowers from the trees I commissioned her for to be used in Rose and the Alchemist.

Shoutout to Lune for my gorgeous Strawberry Dress outfit in the screenshots!! Check her out [url=https://ko-fi.com/lune/shop]HERE[/url]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2bSyOpH.png[/img]
